title: Moore hands Aquarius document to Benowitz in a supply closet

tellings.quote: And they go in the the the supply closet, he said. And he turned the radio up. And he gave him the thing and said, "I was told to give this to you. Take it with a grain of salt."

plain: In 1981 a UFO researcher named Bill Moore is said to have taken Paul Bennewitz, an Albuquerque man who believed he was picking up alien signals, into a supply closet in Bennewitz's office, turned the radio up, and handed him a paper about a secret government UFO project called Aquarius, saying: "I was told to give this to you. Take it with a grain of salt." The writer Greg Bishop tells this as he heard it, and it matters because it suggests someone was feeding Bennewitz official-looking UFO papers on purpose.
